{{DISPLAYTITLE:ML_LEMPPOT}}
{{TAGDEF|ML_LEMPPOT|[logical]|.FALSE.}}

Description: Enables the use of auxiliary empirical potentials for thermodynamic integration using {{TAG|VCAIMAGES}}.
----
{{TAG|ML_LEMPPOT}}=.TRUE. sets the following defaults:
*{{TAG|ML_LCOUPLE}}=.TRUE.
*{{TAG|ML_RCOUPLE}}=0.0

{{TAG|ML_LEMPPOT}}=.TRUE. requires {{TAG|ML_LCOUPLE}}=.TRUE., so no other values for {{TAG|ML_LCOUPLE}} are permitted.
